description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Urza.
Urza enters the battlefield, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Urza's second ability by tapping the Construct, adding {U}.
Sol Ring resolves.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
